chart.title: World population living in extreme poverty
chart.subtitle:
Extreme poverty is defined as living on less than 1.90 international-$ per day.
International-$ are adjusted for price differences between countries and for price changes over time (inflation).
chart.note: See [this link](https://ourworldindata.org/extreme-history-methods) for the strengths and limitations of this data and how historians arrive at these estimates.
